title: Pipes and Zod validation
objective: Use PipeTransform to turn unknown request payloads into parsed typed data or an explicit 400.
misconception: A malformed body reaches the controller unchanged and may produce an unexpected 500.
acceptance: POST an invalid title to receive 400; POST a valid title and see a normalized payload.
securityBoundary: A TypeScript DTO annotation does not validate incoming JSON without a runtime pipe.
